lines: Summer no longer whites out: its seeds are smaller and the scene shows through. It is still the busiest season and its seeds do not yet come to rest.
The macro camera is fitted, so frame 0 of the film now opens inside the scene with no glass edge. All six cameras frame what they are for.
Merged and verified on main: types clean, 274 tests, build, the same picture twice, the local render proof.
Next: the first blockout round. Two critics from different families judge cameras, timing and layout on fresh packs.
phase 2: 3.45 h used of its 6.00 h box
allowance (before the review): 4.64 h used of 36.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: The four seasons at rest with the real particle engine at its full pool: winter, spring, summer, fall. Hero camera, draft tier. Miniature, base and lights are stand-ins.
The six cameras on the winter stand-in stage. Macro (top middle) is newly fitted: the lit cottage, the lamppost and the foot of the tree, no edge of the glass.
Film B, frame 749 at 60 frames a second, preview, draft
Still: winter rest hero, hd, draft
